name: EPIC 211097829
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 4, 10.2 solar radii and 1.03 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

text.card: A red giant 2,488 parsecs away, 10 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 4, give 1.03 solar masses and 10.2 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,982 K at its surface.
